name: Stašov (Beroun District, Czechia)
description: A yellow vertical stripe at the hoist one quarter of the flag's length, and a green fly with four white wedges radiating from the base of the yellow stripe to the fly edge.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 18 June 2003 (decision No. 23) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
